facts.text: I am planning a birthday gift for my aunt.
I am considering getting my aunt a kitchen appliance.
I am considering kitchen appliances that cost around $100 or less.
I recently got a coffee maker for my mom.
The coffee maker I got for my mom cost around $80.
My mom loves the coffee maker I got her.
I think a slow cooker would be a great option.
I think an immersion blender would be a great option.
I think my aunt would appreciate the convenience and ease of use of a slow cooker.
I want beginner-friendly slow cooker recipes for my aunt.
I think my aunt will appreciate the variety of options and the simplicity of the recipes.
I will choose a 5-quart slow cooker.
I want a slow cooker with multiple heat settings.
I want a slow cooker with a timer.
I think my aunt can easily make a variety of recipes with the slow cooker.
I think my aunt can adjust the cooking time to her liking.
